digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, prerequisite finder/verifier, production batch runner
propositions: Prerequisite plan consistency must be evaluated in isolation without leaking prerequisite IDs or plan text into general review requests, general finder/verifier prompts, or coach system instructions.

Focused prerequisite finder and verifier batching must maintain stable lexicographic order, never split subject or prerequisite plan blocks, and recover from context limits by splitting only finding tuples while preserving complete plan text.

Every readable pinned prerequisite must receive exactly one closed-schema disposition (consistent, finding, or indeterminate with reason code); missing, duplicate, invalid ID, parse failure, or attribution mismatch must map to indeterminate.

Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record must force top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict, even when deterministic DET blockers remain visibly retained in the blocking array with prerequisite_indeterminate=true.

Prerequisite-scoped findings must use a canonical structured identity (four length-prefixed UTF-8 fields: version, finding text, sorted criteria, prerequisite ID) with SHA-256 hash, distinct from the legacy pipe-delimited encoding used by all non-prerequisite findings.

Singleton focused-finder baseline and packed focused-finder results must meet absolute floors (recall ≥0.90, false-acceptance ≤0.10, coverage=1.00, attribution-error=0.00) and pass comparative non-regression gates before production route activation.
